title: Australian Museum, Sydney

buildingCutout.basis: Exclude generic overlaps on the mapped Australian Museum building while preserving adjoining properties.

terrainReference.basis: Original source grade sampled just west of the main College Street sandstone facade near the historic steps.

mapIdentity.provider: Exact named OpenStreetMap main Australian Museum perimeter, William Street corner and photographed portal.
mapIdentity.scope: The named OpenStreetMap building outline fixes the 111 m by about 71 m irregular footprint with the projecting Barnet front, turn into College Street, and the distinct Crystal Hall projection and entrance. Post-construction reports distinguish the historic U-shaped wings, covered yard, Parkes Farmer and the newer eastern building masses.

note: Pickering’s 1872 published view gives the retained College Street giant Corinthian order, plinth, three axial bays, and hipped wing pavilions. NSW Public Works gives the sandstone and the storey arrangement. The 2013 and 2022 CC0 photographs provide the Parkes Farmer windowless wing and the Crystal Hall glazing. Construction and design reports give the crystal entry dimensions, offset and raised access, and Qualla’s original confirms the covered former courtyard.
